findings.title: Duplicated code blocks (655)
findings.evidence: 655 repeated 6-line blocks across 386 files.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared helpers; DRY the repeated logic.

findings.title: Hub module (imported by 12)
findings.evidence: 12 modules depend on this one; churn here is high-blast-radius.
findings.recommendation: Keep it stable and small; move volatile logic out.

findings.title: Deep nesting (depth 9)
findings.evidence: Max indentation depth 9 - control flow is hard to follow.
findings.recommendation: Flatten with early returns / guard clauses; extract inner blocks.

findings.title: High branching density
findings.evidence: 54 branch points over 66 lines.
findings.recommendation: Decompose decision-heavy logic; consider table/strategy dispatch.

findings.title: File opened without context manager
findings.evidence: `open(...)` not wrapped in `with` - handle may leak on error.
findings.recommendation: Use `with open(...) as f:` for deterministic close.
